8. Take a deep breath to fill the chest with air and engage the core

## Procedure

1. Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles to achieve triple extension and accelerate bar upward (-2)
2. Simultaneously extend onto the balls of the feet and shrug shoulders straight up
3. Keep the bar close to the body with arms extended and elbows pointed out
4. Transition feet to a squat stance and quickly pull entire body under the bar
5. Flex hips backward and sit into a quarter squat position to absorb the weight of the bar (-3)
6. Quickly rotate elbows down and then up ahead of the bar to catch it on the front portion of the shoulders
7. Stand erect with feet flat on the ground and shoulders directly over the balls of the feet
